stem:
Students observe a glass of ice and water. The glass is dry on the outside. After ten minutes students see drops of water on the outside of the glass.

Which statement best explains the students’ observations?

options.label: A
options.text: The water vapor in the air changes to a liquid when it touches the cold glass.

options.label: B
options.text: The cold water inside the glass rises and then slides down the outside of the glass.

options.label: C
options.text: The ice in the glass melted and caused the water to overflow the glass.

options.label: D
options.text: The water moved to the outside surface through tiny holes in the glass.
